summary: A crow's nest dated only to the 1930s, in the Kootenai National Forest about five miles ESE of Yaak; now described as ruins.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.com says Ruins; the FFLA list says Abandoned.

events.note: Crow's nest; firelookout.com dates it only to the 1930s

evidence.supports: about five miles east-southeast of Yaak
crow's nest dated to the 1930s; site now ruins
listed under the Kootenai National Forest

corrections.why: The record's gone came from the FFLA 'Abandoned' value. Firelookout.com describes the site as 'Ruins', which matches the ruins status (footings or remains only).

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLA says Abandoned and firelookout.com says Ruins. These describe the site's use and its remains, so they are compatible; ruins is the more specific status.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Three sources only: firelookout.com (one line, '1930s: crows nest. Ruins.'), the FFLA county list (type Crowsnest, status Abandoned), and the Montana Lookouts county page (survey location only). The brief's kind 'platform' matches the vocabulary note that crow's nests are platforms, so no kind correction. No dated history, staffing, photos or fire events found. Two web searches returned only the same pages. A Gaia GPS page calls Beetle Hill a 2.4 mile trail but also shows 0 hiking trails, so it was not used. Elevation 4894 ft is 1491.7 m; not written to facts because the schema has no elevation key.
